name: Mae Nak Phra Khanong
description: Mae Nak Phra Khanong ('Lady Nak of Phra Khanong') is the most popular ghost of Thai folklore: a young woman of the Phra Khanong canal who died with her child in childbirth and returned as a phi tai thang klom to live with her unsuspecting husband Mak. Her shrine at Wat Mahabut in Bangkok remains a major pilgrimage site.

aliases.name: Amdaeng Nak
aliases.meaning: Earlier Thai title used in 19th-century newspaper accounts

origin: Mae Nak's narrative and devotional practice are concentrated in Bangkok, particularly in the Phra Khanong / Suan Luang area, but her cultural reach extends throughout Thailand and across the Thai-speaking diaspora.
